description: This header file defines the interface `GatekeeperWindowsChannel` for Windows-based communication with the Gatekeeper service via named pipes. It inherits from `GatekeeperChannel` and provides methods for sending requests and responses, as well as receiving messages, specifically tailored for Windows IPC mechanisms.

classes.name: GatekeeperWindowsChannel
classes.description: A class implementing a communication channel over Windows named pipes for Gatekeeper IPC/RPC calls, providing methods to send requests and responses and to receive messages.
